title: Cool, but overpriced and had a minor defect.
text:
Cool, but overpriced and had a minor defect.. [[VIDEOID:8d81c3d3cc19ca4c79dc72e1a39ecf20]] I wanted to love this skeleton animatronic, however I can’t. He arrives in a box with a pole that connects to him. There was a screw stuck in the pole connected to the skeleton’s body, so I was not able to connect the attachment. I had to modify it to get it to work. If this was checked better by quality assurance it wouldn’t have this issue.

Once I finally got the skeleton working, he is cool. He requires 3 x AA batteries (not included). He says some funny sayings as well and lights up.

One last thing is that he is overpriced. I wouldn’t pay over $40 for a prop like this.
